ios.desc:
The gym tracker that respects your wallet and your privacy. One-time purchase. No subscriptions. No ads. No tracking. Just you and your workouts.

Rakoon is a powerful workout tracker designed for lifters who take their training seriously. Track every rep, analyze your progress with real powerlifting metrics, and keep your data 100% private.

WHY RAKOON?
Unlike Strong ($79.99/yr), Hevy ($49.99/yr), or Fitbod ($79.99/yr), Rakoon has NO monthly subscription. Pay once ($24.99), own it forever. Every future update included. Your gym buddy for life.

TRACK YOUR WORKOUTS
- Log sets, reps, and weight for any exercise
- 40+ pre-loaded exercises across all muscle groups
- Track cardio with duration and distance
- Add notes and RPE (effort level) to each set
- Configurable rest timer between sets
- Create unlimited custom exercises

APPLE WATCH COMPANION
- Real-time heart rate monitoring during workouts
- 5 heart rate zones: Recovery, Fat Burn, Cardio, Hard, Peak
- Live heart rate graph on your wrist
- Zone-based haptic alerts when you enter a new zone
- Works with Polar, Garmin, and any HR monitor synced to HealthKit

LIVE ACTIVITIES & WIDGETS
- Lock Screen Live Activity: timer, exercise, heart rate, sets completed
- Dynamic Island support
- Home Screen widgets: streak counter and weekly workout history
- Track your progress at a glance without opening the app

POWERLIFTING ANALYTICS
Built for serious lifters with competition-grade metrics:
- DOTS Score — Modern bodyweight-adjusted strength rating
- Wilks Score — Classic relative strength formula (2020 coefficients)
- IPF GL Points — Official competition scoring
- Estimated 1RM — Calculate your max from any working set
- Lift Ratios — Analyze your squat/bench/deadlift balance
- Strength Levels — From Beginner to World Class
- Big 3 Auto-Detection — Tracks your SBD total automatically

DETAILED STATISTICS
- Volume progress charts over time
- Muscle group distribution analysis
- Personal records for every exercise
- Weekly, monthly, yearly, and all-time views
- Calorie burn estimates per workout
- Average workout duration tracking

HEALTHKIT INTEGRATION
- Auto-sync workouts to Apple Health
- Import heart rate from any connected device
- Retroactive HR data capture (works even without Apple Watch)
- Bodyweight sync for accurate strength calculations

EXPORT YOUR DATA
- CSV format for spreadsheets and coaches
- JSON format for developers and data nerds
- Custom date ranges
- Your data, your control — always

PRIVACY BY
